metadata.scenario: A tourist asks for directions and information about the services provided at the downtown visitor center. Category: General Information.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Mary O'Connor. I just had a visit yesterday for my IV therapy. Hi Mary! It’s great to hear from you. How did your visit go yesterday? It went okay, but I’m feeling a bit anxious about the next steps. I understand, it's completely normal to feel anxious. Can I provide you with any specific information or support? Yes, actually. I wanted to confirm the schedule for my next IV therapy. I’ll check your schedule right now. One moment please. Alright, it looks like your next IV therapy session is scheduled for Wednesday at 2 PM, as per our usual routine. That’s right, but is there any chance I could get a caregiver who is particularly soothing? Of course, we can definitely arrange for a caregiver who specializes in providing reassurance during medical procedures. That would make me feel a lot better. I just need someone who can help me stay calm. I’ll note that and ensure the caregiver is informed about your preferences. Thank you, Margaret. Also, can you remind me about the charges for IV therapy? Sure! The cost for IV therapy administration is $120 to $150, depending on the duration and specific needs. Okay, I’ll keep that in mind. But what if I need additional support? We also offer respite care and companion services if you need more assistance at home. That sounds helpful. What are the rates for those services? Respite care is $30 to $38 per hour, and companion care ranges from $25 to $30 per hour. Great, I might consider that. Can you send me information on those services? Absolutely! I’ll get that sent over to you via email. Can I confirm your email address? Yes, it’s mary.oconnor@email.com. Got it! I’ll send the information right after our call. Thank you so much, Margaret. I really appreciate your help. It’s my pleasure, Mary. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? No, that’s everything for now. Thanks again! You’re very welcome! Have a wonderful day, and we'll see you on Wednesday. I will, see you then! Bye now!
